concepts.name: Newton's Second Law
concepts.simple_definition: Newton's second law states that acceleration is directly proportional to net force and inversely proportional to mass.
concepts.deep_explanation: The mathematical formula is F_net = ma. If force is constant, increasing the mass decreases the acceleration.
concepts.real_example: Pushing an empty shopping cart is easier (accelerates faster) than pushing a full one with the same force.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking force is needed to keep an object moving at a constant velocity.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: የኒውተን ሁለተኛ ሕግ እንደሚያሳየው ማጣደፍ ከሚያርፈው ኃይል ጋር ቀጥታ የሚመጣጠን ሲሆን ከቁሱ ክብደት ጋር ደግሞ በተቃራኒው ይመጣጠናል (F = ma)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: የሂሳብ ቀመሩ F = ma ነው። የሚገፋው ኃይል ቋሚ ከሆነ፣ የቁሱ ክብደት ሲጨምር ማጣደፉ ይቀንሳል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: ባዶ የገበያ ጋሪን መግፋት፣ ተመሳሳይ ኃይል ተጠቅሞ የተሞላውን ከመግፋት የበለጠ ፍጥነት ይሰጣል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: አንድ ነገር በቋሚ ፍጥነት እንዲጓዝ ሁልጊዜ ኃይል ያስፈልገዋል ብሎ ማሰብ።
